diagnosis: The staging performance benchmark endpoint looks up query execution plans and database profiling metrics by reportId without checking whether the report belongs to the authenticated user's organization. An unauthorized developer can review internal query execution plans, table structures, and indexing bottlenecks of other microservices and tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /staging/benchmarks/reports/rep_perf_pg_order_pipeline_01 HTTP/1.1
Host: staging-perf.mesh.io
Authorization: Bearer dev_user_token
